elder_merchant.speaker: SARTHAVAHA DEV
elder_merchant.text: Greetings, {{playerName}}. Ujjayini is the great crossroads where the northern Uttarapatha meets the Dakshinapatha.

elder_merchant.speaker: SARTHAVAHA DEV
elder_merchant.text: Before you lead your caravan toward Bharukaccha, let us review your knowledge of ancient routes and trade.

narrator_ujjain.speaker: SARTHAVAHA DEV
narrator_ujjain.text: Greetings, {{playerName}}. Ujjayini is the great crossroads where the northern Uttarapatha meets the Dakshinapatha.

narrator_ujjain.speaker: SARTHAVAHA DEV
narrator_ujjain.text: Before you lead your caravan toward Bharukaccha, let us review your knowledge of ancient routes and trade.

npc_textile.speaker: VASANTI
npc_textile.text: Salutations, {{playerName}}. Our loom-workers dye this fine cotton with local indigo. Southern and coastal markets pay handsomely for our cloth.

npc_spice.speaker: CHANDRAN
npc_spice.text: Cardamom and dried hill cloves, {{playerName}}. Caravans bringing spices up from the southern hills find eager buyers in every northern town.

npc_grain.speaker: HARIDAS
npc_grain.text: Well-milled grain and pulse provisions, {{playerName}}. An experienced trader never crosses dry plateau passes without ample food stores.

npc_artisan.speaker: MOHAN
npc_artisan.text: Sturdy terracotta transport jars, {{playerName}}, fired to protect your oils and grain from road dust.

npc_guard.speaker: VEER
npc_guard.text: The Narmada route west to Bharukaccha is clear, {{playerName}}. Fasten your cargo ropes tight against sudden scrub winds.

npc_townsperson.speaker: PRIYA
npc_townsperson.text: Rest beside our banyan tree, {{playerName}}. Caravans from Magadha, Gandhara, and the Deccan have gathered at this square for generations.

narrator_bharuch.speaker: MEERA
narrator_bharuch.text: Welcome to Bharukaccha, {{playerName}}. Here the Narmada River meets the western sea, and overseas merchants dock with seasonal winds.

narrator_bharuch.speaker: MEERA
narrator_bharuch.text: Let us see if you understand the coastal tides and sea lanes that connect our shores across the waters.

npc_bharuch_meera.speaker: MEERA
npc_bharuch_meera.text: Welcome to Bharukaccha, {{playerName}}. Dhows arriving from the Arabian Sea bring copper and silver coins to trade for our beads and inland cloth.

npc_bharuch_meera.speaker: MEERA
npc_bharuch_meera.text: Coastal routes lead southward to Muciri. Inland textiles and fine grains fetch high value among coastal seafarers.

npc_bharuch_sailor.speaker: VIKRAM
npc_bharuch_sailor.text: Fair winds, {{playerName}}! The seasonal monsoon winds guide our sailing craft southward toward the Malabar Coast. Keep your cargo dry!

npc_bharuch_salt.speaker: NAYAN
npc_bharuch_salt.text: Pure white sea salt harvested from the tidal flats, {{playerName}}. Inland kingdoms value salt above almost all common trade.

narrator_muziris.speaker: KALYAN
narrator_muziris.text: Welcome to Muciri, {{playerName}}. You stand at the great spice emporium of the Malabar Coast.

narrator_muziris.speaker: KALYAN
narrator_muziris.text: Foreign and inland merchants travel far across ocean and mountain for our Black Pepper. Let us test your knowledge of coastal trade.

npc_muziris_kalyan.speaker: KALYAN
npc_muziris_kalyan.text: Our hill harvests yield the finest black pepper, {{playerName}}. Foreign merchant vessels anchor in our lagoon specifically for our harvests.

npc_muziris_kalyan.speaker: KALYAN
npc_muziris_kalyan.text: Load your ox carts with pepper and cardamom, {{playerName}}, before taking the Palakkad Gap pass inland to Madurai.

npc_muziris_marcus.speaker: YAVANA SEAFARER
npc_muziris_marcus.text: Greetings, {{playerName}}! We sail from western waters with silver coinage, glassware, and wine amphorae to trade for your black pepper.

npc_muziris_sailor.speaker: UNNI
npc_muziris_sailor.text: The river waters join the sea lagoon here, {{playerName}}. Our thatched quayside sheds protect your delicate spices from the damp rains.

narrator_madurai.speaker: SUNDARAM
narrator_madurai.text: Vanakkam, {{playerName}}. Welcome to Madurai, ancient capital of the Pandyan kings along the Vaigai River.

narrator_madurai.speaker: SUNDARAM
narrator_madurai.text: Let us see what you know of southern weaving guilds, Gulf of Mannar pearl fisheries, and ancient trade assemblies.

npc_madurai_weaver.speaker: SUNDARAM
npc_madurai_weaver.text: Vanakkam, {{playerName}}! Madurai raw cotton and woven fabrics are prized in northern cities for their softness and strength.

npc_madurai_pearl.speaker: VALLI
npc_madurai_pearl.text: Natural sea pearls brought by divers from the Gulf of Mannar, {{playerName}}! In the grand capital of Pataliputra, these jewels fetch royal sums.

npc_madurai_artisan.speaker: KANNAN
npc_madurai_artisan.text: Carved stone oil lamps and granite pestles, {{playerName}}. Crafted with care to endure long caravan travel across the Deccan.

narrator_pataliputra.speaker: ACHARYA SUTRADHAR
narrator_pataliputra.text: Welcome, {{playerName}}. You stand in Pataliputra on the sacred Ganga—the imperial seat of the Mauryan Empire.

narrator_pataliputra.speaker: ACHARYA SUTRADHAR
narrator_pataliputra.text: Here the Arthashastra guides state commerce. Let us test your understanding of imperial markets, tolls, and continental routes.

npc_patali_guard.speaker: ARYAMAN
npc_patali_guard.text: Salutations, {{playerName}}. Imperial toll registers show your caravan has journeyed across ancient trade routes to reach the Ganga!

npc_patali_silk.speaker: DEVAPALA
npc_patali_silk.text: Imperial fine cloth and Gangetic polished ware, {{playerName}}. Only verified goods of high craftsmanship trade within the Royal Bazaar.
